question: When a BTC instrument is closed (ETF, CME futures) but BTC trades 24/7, how much of the spot move is reflected at reopen?
method: For each closure of a BTC instrument (IBIT ETF: official close to next official open, weekends and holidays; CME BTC futures front month: Friday close to Sunday reopen), compare the instrument's reopen return with the BTC spot return over the exact same window. Spot = Coinbase BTC-USD 1-minute candle open at the close and reopen instants (US/Eastern, DST-aware, NYSE early closes handled).

fields.possible_roll: front-month roll weekend; exclude from gap studies
fields.gap_filled_within_5d / hours_to_fill: CME: did futures trade back to Friday close within 5 trading days

sources: Alpaca market data v2 (IBIT official daily open/close, SIP) - only returns are published here
Yahoo Finance BTC=F 60m (CME front month) - only returns and basis are published here
use: Benchmark for 24/7-vs-closed-market price discovery (e.g. tokenized or perpetual equities trading while exchanges are closed). Factual, not investment advice.
